# server_version=200, events.jsonl sha256 prefix: 81e43254856879c6.
# Replays FA group replacement against a non-FA paper account: ReplaceConfig
# is fire-and-forget and returns once the frame is sent; the Gateway answers
# twenty milliseconds later with code 321 "FA data operations ignored for non
# FA customers", which matches no route and the engine drops, so the public
# surface of the blocker is silence and the capture is the record.
# Account identifiers are sanitized to the DU9000001 redaction token.
# Trimmed: farm-status frames and the startup safety global cancel with its
# foreign code-161 replies.

client replace_fa {"fa_data_type":"1"}
